tagline: Spec-driven control plane orchestrating parallel agents.
keyFeatures: Control plane exposing the full execution plan of agents (Zenflow = brain, Zencoder = engine)
RED/GREEN/VERIFY loops with built-in verification gates
Parallel execution — tens to hundreds of agents in isolated worktrees
Cross-provider review: one model writes, another reviews/audits
Triggers: run workflows on schedule, webhook, PR event, or Jira ticket
Zenflow desktop app (macOS/Windows) is free; open sandboxes in your IDE
limitations: Zenflow app is free, but the Zencoder execution engine is a paid platform
Spec rigor depends on the engine model — quality varies by provider
